The selected external opaque 1024x1024 source is 788,520 bytes, SHA-256 40F9E81254A0792B967889808BD8BD8DE33DBDE5EAB7C4CBB1B336DD02BC54A5; it remains untouched outside the repository. Exact-output review found one isolated generic Wizard, exactly two bead eyes, one small mouth, one empty upward-facing palm, no text, logo, official Nimiq art, recognizable third-party character, or Sorcerers input. BFL's pinned model license is Apache-2.0; its current terms state that BFL claims no ownership in outputs while leaving input/output rights and lawful use with the user. WP-015B2H applied only deterministic white-background/contact-shadow removal, white-matte edge decontamination, connected-subject selection, uniform scale, and translation through frozen config 2AAEF899BD9FDBE202D5D9A293F1DC971ED62AAC32ED95095AF662FE6567D644 and normalizer B4AEF73CC30133F622C131A8E8D0322DECF953F933FEFC4EE83940FB328CDD82. The resulting 195,820-byte 512x512 RGBA source master maps ground pivot (256,451) and visible palm socket (407,228), preserves clean alpha on dark and light review backgrounds, and reproduced byte-for-byte. This is a source master only: it intentionally has no runtime_path, animation admission, atlas placement, or gameplay integration.
